description: This PHP source file defines the JobTitleService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for managing job titles, including retrieval, deletion, and persistence of job title data and associated attachments.

classes.name: JobTitleService
classes.description: Service class managing job titles and related attachments within OrangeHRM, implementing typical CRUD operations and normalization.

methods.name: getJobTitleDao
methods.description: Returns the JobTitleDao instance, instantiating it if not already set.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job titles, filtered by active status.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Marks specified job titles as deleted.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Fetches a JobTitle entity by its ID.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a JobSpecificationAttachment entity by its ID.

methods.name: getJobTitleArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized JobTitleModel instances.

methods.name: getJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized JobTitleModel instances for a specific employee.
